textbookText: Jean-François Dobremez (1941-2009), a distinguished French ecologist, left an indelible mark on Nepal's ecological understanding and biogeography. He delineated four belts and 11 bioclimatic zones, identified 75 vegetation types, and 118 ecosystems. His research laid the foundation for conservation efforts in Nepal, preserving its rich biodiversity. Dobremez's extensive field expeditions between 1969 and 1974, spanning over 15,000 kilometers, involved French researchers and Nepalese botanists, enriching Nepal's ecological knowledge.
